content: Two-way landscape in push/webhook tools (synthesis, 2026-08): ntfy = closest self-hosted analog via per-notification http action buttons (up to 3; client device fires HTTP request directly at publisher-defined URL with method/headers/body; one-shot, no free text, no aggregation, no identity of tapper); Telegram bots = full two-way (inline keyboard callback_data 64B + callback_query + answerCallbackQuery + editMessageText; state held by bot); Slack/Discord = two-way only for full apps (interactivity request URL / application-owned webhook), incoming-webhook-only is one-way; Bark/Gotify/ServerChan/PushDeer strictly one-way. Nobody offers group channel + per-message quick replies + free-text reply + callback to arbitrary sender URL without running a bot/app. PushHub combo (Channel Key group + sender-supplied options + callback_url) is unoccupied territory.
